_note_provenance: NOT live-verified — deduced entirely from name-matching against https://github.com/dualznz/toliss-a430-datarefs (datarefs.txt/commands.txt), fetched 2026-08-12. Every entry below should be confirmed with tools/discover.mjs against a real running ToLiss Airbus before trusting it. See _gap_* notes for the pieces that had no plausible match at all in that static list and were left unwired rather than guessed.
_note_screen_and_radio_dont_transfer: This profile is EFIS only. MCDU's screen (not just its keys) and the Radio panel both assume a data shape ToLiss doesn't share — see docs/dataref-inventory.md's sibling research notes (ask if you want those written up too) — porting those needs real code changes, not just a new profile.
_gap_BRG1_BRG2: No BRG-named command or dataref found at all (only NDBBearingArray/VORBearingArray, which look like computed *display* values for the bearing pointer needles, not the physical ADF/OFF/VOR selector switch position). Our own A330 profile's toggleSwitches (BRG1/BRG2, each 3 positions) has no ToLiss equivalent in this list. Left out entirely — needs live discovery to even confirm ToLiss's real hardware here has a directly-analogous 3-position switch.

readouts.name: BARO
readouts.label: QNH
readouts._note_value: Absolute baro *value* dataref not confirmed — ToLiss's own list only has BaroKnobRotationCapt (a rotation delta/counter, not an absolute setting) plus BaroStdCapt/BaroUnitCapt. Assumes the value itself is still the generic X-Plane dataref (same one our own profile uses), since baro setting isn't an Airbus-specific concept the way STD/unit display logic is.
readouts._note_unit_ring: AirbusFBW/BaroUnitCapt confirmed directly writable (not a command pair like the stock A330's setInHg/setHpa) — efis-adapter.js's setReadoutUnit()/efis-panel.js's wireBaroKnob() now support this shape generically (writes 0/1 directly, falling back from the command-pair path when unitArc has no startCommand/endCommand).

readouts.name: MODE
readouts._note: Our own A330 profile uses paced increment/decrement commands for MODE (no writable dataref). ToLiss's own list has no equivalent knob-turn command at all for NDmodeCapt — deduced (by analogy with RANGE, which is in the same situation) that it's directly writable instead. Unconfirmed; if it turns out ToLiss *does* have discrete turn commands, this should switch to the commands.increment/decrement shape instead.

readouts.name: RANGE
readouts._note: Modeled as directly writable, same shape as our own A330 profile's RANGE (which already has no discrete commands) — AirbusFBW/NDrangeCapt looks like the same kind of plain index dataref. Unconfirmed live.

readouts.name: AVIONICS
readouts._note: No ToLiss-specific override found — assumes the generic X-Plane dataref (already true in our own A330 profile too).
